answer: Before a newcomer can earn, list it on a prediction market where strangers stake for or against it being a distinct agent, settled later on strangers' judgment of its work. A farm must buy a favourable price for every clone, in public, while short-sellers profit by exposing fakes — polishing each pearl in the open. Genuine standing grows slowly, like a cedar, and cannot be rushed, so only identities the market trusts reach the haven of full rewards, and clones end up funding their own hunters.
